definitions.gloss: big laugh; hearty laughter; roar of laughter
definitions.explanation: Laughing loudly and heartily. Can describe the act of laughing hard or something that is laughable or absurd.

examples.japanese: みんなで{大笑|おおわら}いした。
{彼|かれ}の{失敗談|しっぱいだん}を{聞|き}いて{大笑|おおわら}いした。
examples.english: I had a big laugh hearing about his blunder.

examples.japanese: あのコメディアンの{舞台|ぶたい}を{見|み}に{行|い}ったら、{最初|さいしょ}から{最後|さいご}まで{大笑|おおわら}いだった。
examples.english: When I went to see that comedian's show, it was non-stop laughter from start to finish.

notes:
USAGE:
{大笑|おおわら}い can be used as a noun ({大笑|おおわら}いだった — it was a big laugh) or with する ({大笑|おおわら}いする — to laugh heartily). It describes loud, uninhibited laughter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大笑|おおわら}いする (to burst out laughing)
- {大笑|おおわら}いされる (to be laughed at heartily)
- {腹|はら}を{抱|かか}えて{大笑|おおわら}い (laughing so hard you hold your stomach)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{爆笑|ばくしょう} is an even more intense term meaning to roar with laughter. {苦笑|くしょう} means a bitter or awkward laugh.
